sources.freshness_role: Official October CPI result released at 08:30 ET: CPI-U +0.4% month over month after +0.6% in September, core +0.3%. BLS records that many 12-month changes cannot be published because October 2025 survey data were unavailable.
Independent same-day coverage confirms +0.4% CPI and +0.3% core CPI and reports each was 0.1 percentage point above forecast; used for result cross-check and freshness only.
Public discussion asks whether CPI-hour trading size fits a funded-account daily-loss boundary. Its backtest/range figures are not used as fact, expected move, price or execution evidence.
Public CPI-day risk note discusses setting size and maximum loss in advance; quotations and claims are not used as fact or execution evidence.

decision.reopen_trigger: Reopen only on a BLS/AP correction or later independently verified fact that changes the calculation question. If reopened, refresh the current U.S. result-risk draft rather than create another generic CPI article.
decision.rationale: Unlike the prior calendar-only observation, the BLS result is published and independently reported. Current public discussion contains an attributable non-directional daily-loss/size question. The reader-facing arithmetic is deliberately separated from CPI reaction and uses declared teaching variables; it refreshes the existing U.S. post-result risk draft instead of duplicating the macro path.
